title: Recent progress in generalized Hamiltonian gradient flow: Singularities
summary: This paper is a survey of the generalized Hamiltonian gradient flow (GHGF) framework for Hamilton-Jacobi equations, with an emphasis on the propagation of singularities and its connections to weak KAM theory, optimal transport and mean field control. In addition to reviewing the main ideas and known results, we present two new contributions.
